name: com.fulfield/mcp
title: Fulfield
description: Find fulfillment partners (3PLs and warehouses) by town, state or name in Fulfield's directory.

tools.name: search_fulfillment_partners
tools.description: Search Fulfield's directory for partners (3PLs and warehouses) in a town/city, state/region, or by business name. At least one of city, state, or name is required; country and service only narrow the search. Returns at most 10 matches and never a directory-wide total or complete town list, so results are not a count of the directory. A search that names no place or business returns no partners and a needsPlace sentence for the user.

state.description: State, province or region. A U.S. state by its code or its name ("NC" or "North Carolina"); elsewhere as the address writes it, for example "Lazio"

country.description: Narrows a search to one country: a two-letter code such as "US", or its name. Not enough on its own

service.description: Only partners offering this kind of service. Not enough on its own

name.description: Part of the partner's business name, at least two characters

limit.description: How many partners to return, 1 to 10 (default 10)
